title: Autosomal recessive carrier couple
goal: Show an affected child of two unaffected autosomal-recessive carriers.

rubric.must: The pedigree visibly shows the two carrier parents.
The drawing visibly shows a carrier male and carrier female joined as parents.
The drawing visibly marks an affected proband child.
Roman generation labels and individual identifiers are visibly ordered across generations.
Standard pedigree sex and affected/carrier symbol fills are visibly distinguishable.
Partnership and parent-child lines make biological relationships unambiguous.

ideal.notes: Both parents drawn as left-half-filled autosomal carriers above one sibship line carrying unaffected II-1, the solid-filled proband II-2, and unaffected II-3.
